name: Tiroler Bergbau- und Hüttenmuseum Brixlegg
kurzbeschreibung: The Mining and Smelting Museum in Brixlegg: mining history of the Lower Inn Valley with copper smelting, Fugger tradition, and a rich mineral collection.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Tyrolean Mining and Smelting Museum in Brixlegg transports visitors into the fascinating world of historical mining and metal smelting, which shaped the region for centuries. It is a living testament to the hard work and technical progress that once contributed to Tyrol's prosperity. Here, the history of copper and silver mining, as well as the associated smelters, is vividly presented, creating a deep understanding of the living and working conditions of that time. The museum offers a unique opportunity to grasp the significance of these industries for the development of the country.

Route & Requirements

The museum is easily accessible for all age groups and requires no special physical conditions. It is located in the center of Brixlegg and is well signposted. The exhibition rooms are designed to be barrier-free, so that people with limited mobility can also easily explore the exhibits. A tour of the museum usually takes about one to two hours, depending on how intensively one wishes to engage with the individual thematic areas. There are no specific route requirements; the visit can be individually planned.

Visit & Arrival

The Tyrolean Mining and Smelting Museum Brixlegg is easily accessible by car via the Inntal motorway A12 (exit Kramsach/Brixlegg). Free parking is available directly at the museum. Arrival by public transport is also straightforward: Brixlegg train station is only a few minutes' walk away and is regularly served by regional trains. Current opening hours and admission prices can be found on the museum's official website. It is advisable to check the exact times before your visit to ensure a smooth experience.

Tips

Plan enough time to explore the diverse exhibits and interactive stations at your leisure. Particularly recommended is participation in one of the regularly offered guided tours, led by experienced guides, which provide deeper insights into the history and technology of mining. For families with children, there are often special offers and child-friendly explanations that make the visit exciting even for the youngest explorers. After the museum visit, the charming village of Brixlegg invites you to a leisurely stroll or a stop at one of the local inns to end the day relaxed.
preis: Adults approx. €6.00, children approx. €3.00, family ticket approx. €14.00
oeffnungszeiten: May to Oct Tue & Fri 14:00–17:00, Sat 10:00–13:00 (groups year-round by appointment)
